description: This PHP source file defines the class Opencart.Admin.Model.Design.SeoUrl, which manages SEO URL data within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving SEO URLs based on various filters and identifiers.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A class extending the Opencart system engine model that provides methods for managing SEO URL data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving URLs based on various filters.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO URL record into the database with specified store ID, language ID, key, value, keyword, and sort order. Returns the ID of the newly inserted record.

methods.name: editSeoUrl
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO URL record identified by its ID with new key, value, keyword, store ID, language ID, and sort order.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrl
methods.description: Deletes an SEO URL record from the database based on the SEO URL ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Deletes SEO URLs matching a specific key-value pair, with optional filtering by store ID and/or language ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Removes all SEO URLs associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all SEO URLs associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a single SEO URL record by its ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Fetches a SEO URL record matching a specific key and value, filtered by store and language IDs.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record by its keyword, filtered by store and optionally by language.

methods.name: getSeoUrls
methods.description: Returns a list of SEO URLs, possibly filtered and sorted based on provided criteria, including search, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Gets all SEO URLs grouped by store and language, filtered by key and value.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Returns all SEO URLs for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Returns all SEO URLs for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalSeoUrls
methods.description: Returns the total count of SEO URL records, optionally filtered by various search criteria.
